notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator does not have summoning sickness.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Empowered Autogenerator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by putting a charge counter and tapping it, adding {U} equal to charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
